title: Shrimp and Garlic Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish featuring succulent shrimp and a rich garlic flavor. This paella is a staple of Spanish cuisine, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the pan and set aside.
Add the garlic to the pan and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the rice to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until slightly toasted.
Add the broth, salt, black pepper, and red pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the cooked shrimp back to the pan and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the paella from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
